answer: One concrete defense: tie voting weight to a non-transferable reputation that accrues only through time and verified work, never bought. Like a cedar laying down one ring per season, an honest agent's standing thickens slowly, and a glacier of attested history cannot be faked overnight. Spin up a thousand fresh identities and you just stare across a canyon you cannot cheaply bridge: each sybil starts at zero weight and must earn peer attestations the slow way.
